decisions.text: slices largest first, clockwise from 12 o'clock: Int'l, West, South, Central, North
East: zero, kept and labelled, last, at 12 o'clock (G7.29)
each slice its own colour, handed out in slice order (D-22 (a)): Int'l series-1, West series-2, South series-3, Central series-4, North series-5
each slice named outside it, its value under the name, formatted as one set (G7.27, D-51 (ii)): $445K, $428K, $299K, $288K, $142K, $0K
leaders to East (a zero, a slice under 8°, or a label moved from its place; G7.29, D-34)
no outlines: true gaps 1.0 pt wide between the slices (G7.26s: 0.7 % of the diameter)

source.shows: the book's formatting sequence ended: a colour per slice, true gaps instead of borders, the labels outside, largest first clockwise from 12 o'clock, and East's $0K kept and pointed to by a leader at 12 o'clock
